task: Fix producer event creation flow blocked by impossible auto-publication contract
evidence: Cutinapp EventCreatePage sends is_published=1 and then throws unless response.event.is_published === true.
API EventManagementController::store intentionally forces is_published=false and instructs producer to configure at least one ticket before publish.
API publish endpoint correctly requires at least one available ticket, so automatic publication during event creation is impossible by design.
The mismatch creates the event successfully but reports failure to the producer and blocks navigation to /ticket/create?eventId=<id>, preventing the first sellable ticket from being configured.
next_point: Remove the impossible publication assertion/request from event creation, keep event as draft, route to first-ticket creation, then publish only after a sellable ticket exists.
